featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely disappointed with Pantaloons. Their parking system is nothing short of a scam. They say the parking fee is refundable, but if you don’t purchase anything, you don’t get the money back. Nowhere is this mentioned on the board, which is completely misleading.

To make matters worse, the staff is extremely arrogant. A person at the cash counter named Rishit was unbelievably rude, unprofessional, and not at all willing to resolve the issue. Instead of helping, he argued and showed zero respect for the customer.

This is not the kind of service expected from a reputed brand. Very poor experience — I would never recommend visiting this place.

featured_reviews.review_text:

There’s a good variety of trendy and affordable outfits for men, women, and kids. I especially liked how neatly everything was displayed — it made choosing much easier. The staff was friendly and helpful without being pushy, which I truly appreciated.

Overall, it’s a great place to shop for stylish clothes at reasonable prices. I’ll definitely be visiting again for my next shopping trip!

featured_reviews.name: Rasesh kumar Dash
featured_reviews.review_text:
Zudio Mall in Borivali is a great place for budget-friendly fashion shopping and is especially popular among people looking for trendy styles at affordable prices. The store offers a wide range of clothing for men, women, and kids, including casual wear, ethnic options, activewear, and seasonal collections. The designs are modern and updated regularly, which makes every visit feel fresh and worth exploring.
One of the biggest advantages of Zudio is its pricing. Most items are reasonably priced, making it easy to shop without worrying about overspending. The store layout is spacious and well organized, with clear sections for different categories, which helps in browsing comfortably even during busy hours. Trial rooms are usually clean and well maintained.
Staff members are generally polite and supportive, helping customers with sizes and basic queries when needed. Billing is smooth and efficient, though queues can get a bit long during weekends and festive seasons. The store is well located in Borivali and easy to reach by public transport.
Overall, Zudio Borivali delivers excellent value for money. It is a reliable choice for everyday clothing and trendy outfits, especially for shoppers who want good style at economical prices.

featured_reviews.name: Siddhant Shamkuwar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I understand that stores may have policies requiring use of trial rooms, but at this Zudio store
the trial room queues were extremely long. I was only checking the fit of a buttoned shirt over my existing T-shirt in an open area when a staff member stopped me in a manner that felt unnecessarily rude and embarrassing.

The issue is less about the policy and more about how it was communicated. Better customer handling and improved trial room management would make the shopping experience much better.

featured_reviews.name: Vrushabh Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Here is a more professional version of your feedback

1) The cleanliness of the washroom did not meet expectations.

2) There was a limited variety of options available, and some sizing issues were observed.

3) There were no seating arrangements provided for customers.
4) The checkout process was slow, as the cashier took an extended amount of time to process transactions.

5) Overall, the management of the establishment appeared to be lacking, impacting the overall experience.

Let me know if you need further adjustments.
